title: Kiosk Idle: All Active Checkouts
lede: The gear counter can now see every open checkout from the resting dashboard without first knowing that a future return is hidden behind a filter.

stats.n: Same four-checkout fixture; the tomorrow row is no longer excluded
Future custody is visible on arrival
Overdue first, then earliest return time

sections.heading: Matched idle dashboard
sections.note: Same source-controlled baseline, same fixture data, same iPad Air 11-inch Simulator, and fresh app state. The live clock differs only because captures are time-driven.

pairs.title: Left custody rail
pairs.sub: Look for Softball Road Kit, due tomorrow at 9:00 AM.
pairs.beforeCap: Due Today hides the future checkout even though the Checkouts count is four.
pairs.afterCap: Active Checkouts shows all four, earliest due first, including tomorrow's return.

sections.heading: Summary and urgency follow-up
sections.note: Same four-checkout fixture and iPad Air 11-inch Simulator. The earlier accepted after capture is the baseline for this follow-up.

pairs.title: Default selection and custody order
pairs.sub: Look at the first summary tile and read the return chips from top to bottom.
pairs.beforeCap: Checkouts sits in the middle, while rows follow an out-of-order fixture payload.
pairs.afterCap: Checkouts anchors the row; custody reads overdue, 9:00 AM, noon, then tomorrow.

changes.h: Future custody was hidden by default
changes.was: The resting list filtered the complete dashboard response down to today and overdue, so staff had to tap Checkouts to discover gear due later.
changes.now: The resting list consumes every active checkout and keeps the existing due-time chips and earliest-due-first ordering.

changes.h: The Checkouts toggle would become a no-op
changes.was: Using the old toggle model with the new default would claim to clear a filter while rendering the same rows.
changes.now: Checkouts is the explicit resting selection. Items Out and Overdue temporarily narrow the rail and return to all checkouts when cleared.

changes.h: Layout and payload order disagreed with the default
changes.was: The selected Checkouts tile sat between two other filters, and the view trusted whatever row order arrived from the server or fixture.
changes.now: Checkouts is first, and the native view guarantees overdue-first then earliest-due ordering with a stable title tie-breaker.

verification: 11 focused Vitest assertions pass across the idle-list, ordering, cancellation, and polling-budget contracts.
WisconsinKiosk Xcode verification passes: Simulator build, XCTest suite, and generic iOS build.
Native integrity passes: project parity, 56/56 audit coverage, and zero iOS drift findings after correcting the separate Settings error-color issue.
Repository TypeScript: blocked by unrelated dirty BookingEquipmentTab.tsx references to an unimported Button at lines 273 and 275; the kiosk Swift target builds and tests cleanly.
notes: The matched review uses the repository's DEBUG-only fixture harness; it does not contact production or require a kiosk session.
The Simulator preserved list scroll state on the first updated launch. That invalid capture was discarded; the accepted after image was taken after clearing only the fixture app's Simulator data.
The existing iOS 26 UIRequiresFullScreen deprecation warning remains a documented future landscape-lock migration opportunity.
